site.name: Cala Renee Salon
site.tagline: Changing lives one curl at a time.
site.description: Curl specialists in Beverly, Massachusetts since 1989. Curl-by-curl cuts, botanical color, and Innersense organic beauty.

hero.headline: Cala Renee
hero.blurb: Curl-by-curl cuts, botanical color, and a chair that still feels like a visit. Book. Get directions. Walk in looking like yourself.
hero.imageAlt: Cala Renee Salon chairs and stations

barbers.title: The stylists
barbers.blurb: Six chairs. Book the one whose work looks like you.

servicesPage.title: Services
servicesPage.blurb: Same list as the chair. Color is quoted in the salon. Call to book.

shop.title: Shop
shop.blurb: Innersense Organic Beauty — the same bottles we use on the floor.

find.title: 309 Rantoul
find.hoursNote: Closed Sunday and Monday. We aim for 48 hours’ notice so we can offer your time to another guest.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.blurb: The photos are the cuts. Five stars from the chair.

services.name: Curl by Curl Cut
services.blurb: Hair is sculpted dry, curl by curl, so the shape lives in your natural pattern.

services.name: First Visit Bundle
services.blurb: Consultation, curl-by-curl cut, botanical treat, style, and a plan you can repeat at home.

services.name: Shape & Trim
services.blurb: A tighter appointment for guests who already have the cut. Same dry-sculpt method.

services.name: Kids Curl Cut
services.blurb: Patient chair, same standard. First grown-up curls and the regulars who already know us.

services.name: Botanical Gloss
services.blurb: A sheer, shine-first finish. Tone, refresh, or just make the hair look expensive.

services.name: Pintura & Highlights
services.blurb: Hand-painted dimension for curls that move. Quoted after we see the hair.

services.name: Botanical Color
services.blurb: Full color with a quieter chemical story. Book extra time for a first visit.

services.name: Botanical Treatment
services.blurb: A deep cleanse and treat on its own, or added to a cut.

services.name: Style & Coach
services.blurb: Blowout or curl set, then the product prescription so wash day is not a mystery.

services.name: Occasion Style
services.blurb: Updo, half-up, or a finish that photographs. Bring a reference.

products.name: Sweet Spirit Leave-In
products.blurb: Detangle, soften, and set the curl.

products.name: I Create Hold
products.blurb: The finish we send you home with.

reviews.quote: They taught me how to love my hair on a regular Tuesday. The curl-by-curl cut finally matches what I do at home.
reviews.name: Meredith K.
reviews.avatarAlt: Honey-blonde ringlet curls after a salon finish

reviews.quote: First time I left without fighting my hair in the car. Worth the drive from Salem.
reviews.name: Anne P.
reviews.avatarAlt: Long natural waves, viewed from behind

reviews.quote: Color that still looks like me. Honey, not highlighter. I booked the next one before I put my coat on.
reviews.name: Lauren S.
reviews.avatarAlt: Brunette hair with honey-blonde curls in the chair

reviews.quote: Patient with my daughter’s first grown-up curls. We both left knowing how to do wash day.
reviews.name: Catherine R.
reviews.avatarAlt: Defined curly bob with caramel highlights

reviews.quote: The chair still feels like a visit. They sent me home with a plan, not a pile of product I will never use.
reviews.name: Julia M.

reviews.quote: I thought I had to straighten it to look finished. I was wrong. This is the cut I wanted ten years ago.
reviews.name: Brooke H.
reviews.avatarAlt: Long dark brown waves, polished finish

barbers.name: Elena Moreau
barbers.quote: The cut has to live in the curl, not on top of it.
barbers.bio: Elena runs the floor the way Cala taught it — dry, slow, and honest about what the hair will actually do on a Wednesday.

barbers.name: Brooke Langford
barbers.quote: If it only looks good in the chair, it is not finished.
barbers.bio: Brooke takes the long appointments — weddings, first big cuts, the hair that has been over-styled for a decade.

barbers.name: Claire Whitfield
barbers.quote: Color should move when the curl moves.
barbers.bio: Claire paints for bounce, not for Instagram. Highlights that still look expensive six weeks later.

barbers.name: Isabelle Hart
barbers.quote: A good bob on a curl is architecture.
barbers.bio: Isabelle likes a shorter finish and a clean perimeter. Regulars who wear a curly bob sit with her.

barbers.name: Natalie Quinn
barbers.quote: Maintenance is a skill. I like doing it well.
barbers.bio: Natalie keeps the books moving — trims, treats, and the guests who already know exactly what they want.

barbers.name: Camille Voss
barbers.quote: If you cannot do it at home, I did not finish the lesson.
barbers.bio: Camille is the wash-day coach. She will send you out with a bottle and a method, not a mystery.
